text:
[NDLC.2.1] A dialect is defined in a YAML file whose fields are `name`
and `settings` and no other. The compiler must refuse a file holding any other
top-level key ([NDLC.6.1]): a key nothing reads would claim something no tier
does.

```yaml
# Required. The name programs use in their `use` directive.
name: frame

# Required. A setting for every capability of [LCAP.1], by
# stable name: nothing is derived ([NDLC.2.2]). The deferred
# capabilities ([LCAP.2.10]) must be `false`.
settings:
  realtime: false
  constspace: false
  linear_scan: true
  logical: true
  dynamic_ttl: false
  regex: true
  float: true
  call: true
  publish: true
  cache: true
  cache_delete: true
  nocooldown: true
  series: false
  sampled_slots: false
  persist_on_series: false
  storage_hydrate_facts: false
  storage_hydrate_samples: false
```
